sloka: अशोभत तदा रामो धनुर्विष्फारयन् महत्।भगवानिव सङ्क्रुद्धो भवो वेदमयं धनुः ।। ६.७५.३५ ।।
transliteration: aśobhata tadā rāmo dhanurviṣphārayan mahat।bhagavāniva saṅkruddho bhavo vedamayaṁ dhanuḥ ।। 6.75.35 ।।

translations.english: The two great souls, Rama, and Lakshmana, both relieved of pain seized hold of excellent and wellknown bows.
